From f42498705965bd4b026953c1892c686d8b1138e4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2021 14:38:56 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] drm/panfrost: Fix missing clk_disable_unprepare() on error in
 panfrost_clk_init()

Fix the missing clk_disable_unprepare() before return
from panfrost_clk_init() in the error handling case.

Fixes: b681af0bc1cc ("drm: panfrost: add optional bus_clock")
Reported-by: Hulk Robot <hulkci@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Steven Price <steven.price@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Steven Price <steven.price@arm.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20210608143856.4154766-1-weiyongjun1@huawei.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c
index 125ed973feaa..a2a09c51eed7 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c
@@ -54,7 +54,8 @@ static int panfrost_clk_init(struct panfrost_device *pfdev)
 	if (IS_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock)) {
 		dev_err(pfdev->dev, "get bus_clock failed %ld\n",
 			PTR_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock));
-		return PTR_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock);
+		err = PTR_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock);
+		goto disable_clock;
 	}
 
 	if (pfdev->bus_clock) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c`**
- The function `panfrost_clk_init` was modified to include error handling for the `bus_clock` initialization.
- Instead of directly returning the error code when `pfdev->bus_clock` is an error, the code now assigns the error to a variable `err` and uses a `goto` statement to jump to a label `disable_clock`.
- This change allows for a new section of code (not shown in the patch) to be executed that presumably handles the disabling of the clock before returning from the function.

### Relationships
- The modification in `panfrost_device.c` addresses a bug related to resource management in the `panfrost_clk_init` function. Specifically, it ensures that if the initialization of `bus_clock` fails, the function will properly disable the clock using `clk_disable_unprepare()` before returning an error. This change is crucial for preventing resource leaks and ensuring that the system remains stable in the event of an error during clock initialization. The patch is a direct response to a previously identified issue, as indicated by the "Fixes" tag in the commit message.
